title: Polymarket Reportedly Lands $300 Million From 1789 Capital
dek: TechCrunch reports that 1789 Capital, an investment firm associated with Donald Trump Jr., led a $300 million investment in Polymarket as part of a round that could total about $1 billion.
socialCaption: Polymarket reportedly received a $300 million investment from 1789 Capital, with the wider round expected to reach about $1 billion. The next questions: confirmation, terms, and what the capital will fund.
